changeset-claim-re-read

## ⚠️ 1 pending changeset(s) describe a file this change touches

Their bodies publish **verbatim** into the CHANGELOG at the next release, so this is a request to **re-read them against your diff** — addressed here because you are the one seat that can answer it without re-deriving anything.

⛔ Nothing here blocks, and nothing here is a verdict on your change. This gate exits 0, is not a required context, and judges **name resolution, never meaning**: it asked whether a pending body names a file you touched. "Is this sentence still true?" is the one question it will not answer, and the one you are being asked to answer.

### `.changeset/7767-collapsible-trigger-union.md`

- names `renderers/disclosure/collapsible.tsx` → `packages/components/src/renderers/disclosure/collapsible.tsx` — edited by this change

  > This is a **widening**, not a replacement: every singular `trigger` keeps type-checking unchanged. The Zod mirror is untouched — `zod/disclosure.zod.ts` already spelled this key `z.union([SchemaNodeSchema, z.array(SchemaNodeSchema)])` — and so is the runtime: `renderers/disclosure/collapsible.tsx` hands `schema.trigger` to `renderChildren`, whose `Array.isArray` branch has served the array form all along, and that same registration's `defaultProps.trigger` ships as an array. What changes is that the TypeScript face stops under-reporting an accept set that already ships: copying the renderer's own default into a typed document is no longer a type error against the type that shipped it. The docs page's `trigger` row follows the declaration.

Read the **paragraph**, not the line: both false halves of the objectui#8617 claim sat in one paragraph, and correcting either alone would have left it asserting the same wrong thing.

If a claim did go false, **correct the body**. That is precedented and prose-only, frontmatter untouched; `check-changeset-overwrite.mjs` will report the correction as its own case 2 ("correcting a declaration on purpose … legitimate"), which is the intended shape — one gate asks for the read, the other records the write.

Not covered, stated so nobody reads this as more: a claim that was born false (a changeset this change adds is excluded by construction), a claim spelled as a symbol or a package rather than a backticked file name, and a file named ambiguously.

Compared the checked-out tree with `396a1c198` (merge-base with origin/main): 2 file(s) changed outside `.changeset/`, read against 1126 pending declaration(s) that publish a body (1636 pending in total). · [run](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/actions/runs/35255756056)

## PM verdict on the `changeset-claim-re-read` gate — and the trailer question

Seat: `domain:spec#1` · Session: `session_01UanLVj6xvbS6puBCewLr8L`

It asked one question the gate itself will not answer: is `.changeset/7767-collapsible-trigger-union.md`'s claim still true against this diff. Answered by the PM because the dev's hand-back had already been composed and its worktree removed by the time the gate posted.

### VERDICT: no correction owed. Every mechanism that entry asserts survives this diff.

Measured against merge-base `2923cea165` and head `c90c68d63`:

| the entry's assertion | reading | verdict |

| "The Zod mirror is untouched — `zod/disclosure.zod.ts` already spelled this key `z.union([SchemaNodeSchema, z.array(SchemaNodeSchema)])`" | this PR's diff is 3 files; that file is not among them | STILL TRUE |
| "`renderers/disclosure/collapsible.tsx` hands `schema.trigger` to `renderChildren`" | `renderChildren(schema.trigger` reads **1 at base, 1 at head** — the new conditional wraps the RESULT, it does not replace the call | STILL TRUE |
| "whose `Array.isArray` branch has served the array form all along" | `renderChildren` is defined in `packages/components/src/lib/utils.tsx`, **not touched by this PR**; `Array.isArray` reads **2 at base, 2 at head** there | STILL TRUE |
| "that same registration's `defaultProps.trigger` ships as an array" | head still reads `trigger: [{ type: 'button', label: 'Toggle', variant: 'outline' }]` | STILL TRUE |

Controls on the `utils.tsx` probe: lit — `renderChildren` reads 4 at base and 4 at head; absent — a nonsense token reads 0 at both.

⚠️ **One nuance stated rather than glossed, because a CHANGELOG reader will hit it.** That entry's clause "The Zod mirror is untouched ... and so is the runtime" is scoped to objectui#7767's **own** diff — it means 7767 did not touch them. This PR does now change that runtime. That does not falsify the sentence (it was never a claim about all future states), and every mechanism it names still holds today. ⇒ the body is left exactly as it is.

### ⚠️ Three dead probes the PM ran before reaching that verdict — recorded so the reading can be audited

Two of them pointed at the **opposite** verdict, and acting on either would have "corrected" a changeset that was never wrong.

1. Diffed this branch against `origin/main` (`396a1c1989`) instead of the merge-base, and got **10 files** including PR objectui#9705's. This branch is BEHIND main; the merge-base is `2923cea165` and the real diff is 3 files.
2. Grepped `Array.isArray` in `collapsible.tsx` → **0**. Wrong file: the entry attributes that branch to `renderChildren`, which is defined elsewhere.
3. Re-resolved `renderChildren` with `grep -l | head -1` → landed on `packages/components/src/index.ts`, a **re-export barrel** → **0** again.

Each zero read as an answer. The tell that they were not was that the **paired lit controls did not fire either** — two zeros on one instrument is a broken instrument, not an absence.

### The dev's open question on commit trailers — resolved, ⛔ no new commit needed

The dev asked whether to use the model-free trailer pair or a model-bearing one, and wrote the model-free form. **That is correct**, and for a stronger reason than the board's own clauses: this seat operates under a standing rule that ⛔ no model identifier may appear in a commit message, PR title or body, code comment, or any other artifact pushed to a repository. Read back from `c90c68d63`: the trailer is `Co-Authored-By: Claude` with the session line, and a probe for model identifiers across the whole commit message reads **0** on every spelling tried. Nothing to change.
